description: Check a host's TLS certificate from the public certificate-transparency logs: issuer, valid from/until, days left, wildcard, how many names it covers, and whether the zone's CAA records allow that issuer. No connection to the site. at most 20 checks an hour per network and 30 an hour per site checked.

domain.description: The domain to look up (example.com), or any URL on it.

name: check_tls

checks.description: Fails first. `fix` is the one action to take; null on a pass.

facts.description: What was read, as labelled rows. From the site or a registry: unverified.

listing.description: Whether the site is listed on the directory: its page when it is, where to list it when not.

toolUrl.description: The same check as a page on the site.

title: Check the TLS certificate
